briefing.aiDisclosure: Written by AI from the day's article summaries, then checked against the source articles by a separate AI model before publication. Every item links to its source articles.
briefing.editorNoteAuto: "{story}" was the most widely covered story today, reported by {outlets} outlets. Duplicate reports are merged into one item.
briefing.footerNote: This briefing was written by AI from summaries of articles by {outlets}. Each item links to the source article summary and the original report. It is not investment advice.
briefing.localeMissingTitle: This briefing isn't available in English
briefing.emptyTitle: No briefing has been published yet
briefing.emptyBody: Briefings are published every morning. Meanwhile, browse the latest articles.
briefing.dataNoticePartial: {date} was only partially collected ({count} articles; same-weekday-group median {median}).
briefing.dataNoticeReduced: {date} was backfilled later with per-outlet daily caps ({count} articles).
briefing.dataNoticeTail: Article counts in this edition understate actual coverage, so don't read trends from volume.
briefing.withdrawnInModal: This briefing has been corrected or withdrawn.
briefing.compactNotFound: No briefing was published for this date.

briefingAdmin.listHint: Review validated ko drafts and publish them. Publishing also publishes the en/zh drafts translated from that ko version and replaces the date's current edition.
briefingAdmin.noTranslations: No en/zh drafts were translated from this version. Publishing it publishes ko only and takes down the date's current en/zh editions.
briefingAdmin.confirmPublish: Publish {date} ko v{version} and its translations? The date's current edition will be replaced.
briefingAdmin.confirmWithdraw: Withdraw the published {date} edition (all languages)? A withdrawn edition cannot be republished from here.
briefingAdmin.confirmRegenerate: Regenerate {date}? This calls the LLM (about $0.01–0.02, 15–60 s) and creates a new draft version.
briefingAdmin.editTitle: Edit text (saved as a new draft version)
briefingAdmin.editHint: Only the headline, lede and top-story text can be edited. The same validator runs before saving; nothing is saved if a fatal issue remains.
briefingAdmin.saveEdit: Validate and save as new version
briefingAdmin.editOnlyKo: Text can only be edited on the ko version.
briefingAdmin.preview: Preview (same component as the public page)
briefingAdmin.notRenderable: This version has no content (failed or skipped).
briefingAdmin.dataQualityBody: This edition's period includes days with incomplete collection ({days}). Days before 2026-10-13 were backfilled with per-outlet daily caps, so counts are below actual coverage; other days were partially collected. They are excluded from same-weekday comparisons and averages, but figures may change after backfill. It can be published only after you acknowledge this.
briefingAdmin.dataQualityAck: I have reviewed the data notice and want to publish as is
briefingAdmin.weeklyEditNote: Inline editing isn't available for weekly reports yet. If something needs fixing, regenerate or don't publish.
briefingAdmin.confirmPublishWeekly: Publish the {week} weekly report ko v{version}? The week's current edition will be replaced.
briefingAdmin.confirmRegenerateWeekly: Regenerate the {week} weekly report? This calls the LLM (about $0.003–0.008, 10–40 s) and creates a new draft version.
briefingAdmin.previewWeekly: Preview (same component as the public weekly page)
briefingAdmin.slaRule: Weekday editions are due at 09:00 KST the next day; the Sat–Sun combined edition (dated Saturday) is due Monday 09:00 KST. A Telegram alert goes out at 09:30 if unpublished.
briefingAdmin.withdrawReason: Withdrawal reason (required, shown in the public corrections log)
briefingAdmin.withdrawReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Withdrawn due to a figure error in a cited article.
briefingAdmin.withdrawReasonHint: This reason is published in the corrections log. At least 2 characters.
briefingAdmin.confirmPublishMonthly: Publish the {month} monthly report ko v{version}? The month's current edition will be replaced.
briefingAdmin.confirmRegenerateMonthly: Regenerate the {month} monthly report? This calls the LLM (about $0.005–0.015, 15–60 s) and creates a new draft version.
briefingAdmin.previewMonthly: Preview (same component as the public monthly page)
briefingAdmin.monthlyEditNote: Monthly reports don't support inline editing yet. If something needs fixing, regenerate or don't publish.
briefingAdmin.aiReviewNone: No AI review yet. Scheduled reviews run after generation and publish automatically when they pass.
briefingAdmin.aiReviewUnverified: quote not found in the article
briefingAdmin.aiReviewFixedFrom: This version is v{version} corrected with the AI reviewer's fixes ({n} sentences).
briefingAdmin.aiReviewConfirm: Re-run the AI review on this version? It only records the review and the auto-publish decision; nothing is published.
briefingAdmin.aiReviewGenLog: Generator log: {n} entries (automatic repairs, deletions, warnings)
briefingAdmin.aiReviewGenTargeted: A targeted repair (last attempt before deletion) was applied.

weekly.coverage: Based on {total} public AI articles · {minutes} min read
weekly.aiDisclosure: Figures are computed from our database; the text was written by AI citing only those figures and articles.
weekly.dailyConclusion: Comparing the same weekdays, article volume changed {change} from last week.
weekly.chartEntitiesDesc: Articles naming the company in the title or summary. Changes are shown only when both weeks have 5 or more. {mark} = Chinese company or institution.
weekly.entitiesNote: Mention counts reflect coverage by {count} Chinese outlets, not market share or performance.
weekly.chartRisingDesc: Up 3 or more from last week and at least 4 this week.
weekly.chartFallingDesc: Down 3 or more from at least 4 last week.
weekly.barsDesc: Bar = this week, tick = last week.
weekly.sentFlat: Changes are within 1 percentage point, so we don't treat them as a trend.
weekly.chinaSection: China and overseas, as seen by Chinese media
weekly.chartChina: Share of articles naming Chinese vs overseas players
weekly.chartChinaDesc: This week {foreign}% of articles named an overseas company and {china}% a Chinese company or institution (last week {pforeign}% vs {pchina}%).
weekly.chartChinaDescNoPrev: {foreign}% of articles named an overseas company and {china}% a Chinese company or institution.
weekly.chinaNote: Articles naming both are counted on both sides.
weekly.chinaLensDropped: The AI commentary for this section failed validation, so only the figures are shown.
weekly.moneySub: Amounts as stated in headlines · not summed or converted
weekly.moneyEmpty: No headline this week stated a deal amount.
weekly.moneyNote: Reported amounts extracted automatically from headlines. Revenue and valuation figures are excluded; a deal reported by several outlets appears on several rows. Not investment advice.
weekly.pinyinVariants: Articles spell the pinyin {count} ways; we show the most common one.
weekly.methodBody: Population: public AI articles (business, tech, product), dated by Beijing time. Company names in Korean, Chinese and English are counted under one label. Reposts of the same article are grouped by title similarity, and reports of the same event are grouped again. Days with incomplete collection are excluded from same-weekday comparisons.
weekly.methodMeta: Figures computed {computed} UTC · {prompt} · published after review by a separate AI model
weekly.fixesNone: None yet. If backfilled collection changes the figures, the previous edition and the changed figures will be listed here.
weekly.footer: This report was written by AI using only articles from {count} Chinese outlets ({outlets}) and computed figures, and checked against those sources by a separate AI model. It is not investment advice.
weekly.localeMissingTitle: This weekly report isn't available in English
weekly.localeMissingBody: The {week} weekly report is available in:
weekly.emptyTitle: No weekly report has been published yet
weekly.emptyBody: Weekly reports are published every Monday for the previous week. Meanwhile, read the daily briefing.
weekly.kpiVolumeAvg: Average {avg} per day over {days} fully collected days
weekly.kpiVolumeAllReduced: Every day had reduced collection, so no daily average is shown
weekly.dataNoticeReduced: {range} ({count} days) were backfilled after collection started late, with per-outlet daily caps ({caps}). Article counts for these days are far below actual coverage, so do not read trends from volume; compare companies by share or per 1,000 articles.
weekly.dataNoticeCompare: Week-over-week article counts exclude that weekday in both weeks.
weekly.dataNoticeNoCompare: The comparison week also had reduced collection, so no week-over-week changes are shown.
weekly.dataNoticeTail: Once collection is backfilled, this report will be recalculated and changes logged under “Corrections”.
weekly.dailyConclusionExcluded: {count} reduced or partial days are excluded from the average.
weekly.dailyConclusionAllReduced: Every day had reduced collection, so volume cannot show a trend.
weekly.chartEntitiesDescNoPrev: Articles naming the company in the headline or summary. {mark} = Chinese company or agency.
weekly.chartTopTermsDesc: Based on article key terms, counted once per article.
weekly.chartRegion: Share of articles by subject region
weekly.chartRegionDesc: This week {cn}% of articles were about China, {us}% about the US and {other}% elsewhere (last week China {pcn}%, US {pus}%).
weekly.chartRegionDescNoPrev: {cn}% of articles were about China, {us}% about the US and {other}% elsewhere.
weekly.regionNote: Each article counts once, by its subject region (Taiwan and Hong Kong count as China). {uschina} US–China stories; {unclassified} unclassified articles are left out of the shares.

monthly.chartRisingDesc: Up 3+ from last month and 4+ this month.
monthly.chartChinaDesc: This month {foreign}% of articles named a foreign company and {china}% a Chinese company or agency. Last month: {pforeign}% vs {pchina}%.
monthly.dataNoticeCompare: Month-over-month volume uses the daily average excluding incomplete days.
monthly.dataNoticeNoCompare: Last month had reduced collection, so no month-over-month changes are shown — only week-by-week comparisons within the month (weekday average, per 1,000 articles).
monthly.localeMissingTitle: This monthly report isn't available in English
monthly.localeMissingBody: The {month} monthly report is available in:
monthly.emptyTitle: No monthly report has been published yet
monthly.emptyBody: Monthly reports summarize the previous month early on the 1st and are published once they pass review by a separate AI model. Meanwhile, read the weekly and daily briefings.
monthly.arcSub: Weekday daily average · fully collected days only
monthly.chartMultiplesDesc: Weeks differ in length and volume, so mentions are normalised per 1,000 articles that week. All panels share one y-axis. {mark} = Chinese company or agency.
monthly.multiplesReducedNote: Hatched panels / hollow dots = reduced-collection weeks (per-outlet daily caps). The outlet mix differs, so even per-1,000 values are not directly comparable. * in the table means the same.
monthly.methodMonthly: The month is split into ISO weeks (first and last weeks clipped to the month) to compute weekday daily averages and company mentions per 1,000 articles. Weeks are never compared on raw counts.
monthly.chartRegionDesc: This month {cn}% of articles were about China, {us}% about the US and {other}% elsewhere (last month China {pcn}%, US {pus}%).
